mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (measured as the 1-month change in FEDFUNDS) consistently predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher policy rates compress equity valuations and increase discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS 1-month change > 0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (measured by CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeding 0.5%) signals an impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) signal an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0%), the S&P 500 consistently underperforms, leading to negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5 and CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100 base) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in residential sales (RSAFS) above 390,000 million dollars signals a strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 390000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) exceeding 11701.0 billion dollars signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 11701.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
